name: Overseas Delivery
summary: Fizzgrimble asks you to carry a sealed crate across the sea to Friz Frazzlespark in the Riverglades. Its contents are meant to remain a surprise until it reaches Powderfuse Port.

sections.title: A Careful Crossing
sections.body: Fizzgrimble sends you east toward Steamwheedle Port, where a ship usually offers passage across the sea. The crate is bound for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades. Handle it gently on the way; Fizzgrimble warns against opening or jolting it.

faq.answer: Friz Frazzlespark is waiting for the crate at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

faq.q: Where should I take the crate?
faq.answer: Take it to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

faq.q: Where can I find passage across the sea?
faq.answer: Fizzgrimble recommends heading east to Steamwheedle Port, where a ship usually provides safe passage.

faq.q: What should I do with the crate on the way?
faq.answer: Keep the crate closed and avoid tilting, shaking, or making sudden movements with it.
Friz Frazzlespark asks you to turn around while they look inside, keeping the contents a surprise.
